description.value: East is East is a Vancouver restaurant drawing inspiration from the ancient Silk Road dhabbas, serving Afghan, Persian, Tibetan, and South Asian-influenced cuisine made from natural, whole, and organic ingredients. The Broadway location is one of two Vancouver outposts, offering a candlelit 'Chai Gallery' atmosphere that a food reviewer called 'as if you have been transported into a different world.' Live entertainment is regularly featured, and the menu is notably accommodating to plant-based and gluten-free diners.
